name: Bull
overview: The Bible portrays bulls as symbols of strength and power, as seen in references to the 'strength of an unicorn' in Numbers and Deuteronomy, emphasizing God's mighty deliverance and protection. Bulls are also depicted as formidable adversaries, with Psalms describing 'strong bulls of Bashan' surrounding the psalmist, illustrating challenges believers face. Additionally, the mention of bulls in contexts such as sacrifice highlights their role in worship and atonement, underscoring the significance of their blood in Old Testament sacrificial practices.
